model: Area C regional pressure-interference screening grid

source.seal_horizon: Depth horizons EarthVision\Area C\Top Fjerritslev Formation
source.horizon_vertical_units: metres TVDSS; supplied depth horizons used directly

resolution.rationale: 5 km regional screening resolution; preserves 100-300 km pressure interference while keeping the six-layer model near 26,000 cells

sites.name: Stenlille
sites.kind: CO2 storage structure and natural-gas storage

limitations: Regional screening grid; not a history-matched or permit-ready model.
Area C horizons are resampled from supplied depth-domain surfaces.
Area C NTG and temperature are screening defaults pending complete regional property fields.
Sites outside the Area C extent are retained as reference markers but are not simulated.
Only co-located, ordered horizon triplets were resampled; EarthVision no-data/sentinel cells were excluded.
